CONSULTED: Grokipedia 'Balcerowicz Plan' (browser, 2026-09-05) -- January 1 1990 effective date, 10-law package, 1990-91 GDP contraction ~12%, continuous growth 1992-2008, 2004 EU accession, Polish per-capita tripling. CORROBORATE AT BUILD: exact GDP contraction figures 1990-91; the 1992-2008 no-contraction stretch as commonly cited by IMF and World Bank data.
framing_note: A rare POSITIVE case study of a market-liberalization sequence that WORKED clearly, at scale, in living memory. Dinner-test payoff: T4 (Poland grew every single year for 16 years straight, tripling per-capita income). REASONING-MOVE HIERARCHY: KNOWLEDGE-PROBLEM removed (prices restored) + INCENTIVE restored (hard budgets, private ownership) + Sowell's 'compared to what?' (Poland vs Russia same-decade contrast). ACCURACY RAIL: the 1990-91 contraction was real and painful; do not gloss it -- the ladder's honesty about the transition cost is part of what makes the T4 recovery credible. Second rail: not all post-communist reforms worked; the ladder specifically credits the COHERENT PACKAGE (hard budgets + convertibility + privatization together), not shock-therapy-as-slogan. Third rail: Jeffrey Sachs's later reputation is more complex (post-2000 development-policy debates); the ladder uses him only as a co-advisor of the 1990 Polish reform. ANTI-RESTATEMENT: stem describes the 1989 Solidarity election, the Balcerowicz package, the 1990-91 pain, the 1992-onward growth; the answer is the SPECIFIC OUTCOME (16 years continuous growth, tripled per capita) or the REASONING MOVE (coherent-package hard-budget discipline). DISTRACTOR MINE: other 1990s post-communist transitions (Russia voucher privatization, Czech coupon privatization, Hungarian gradualism, East German unification), other reform-and-growth cases (Estonia, Georgia, Chile 1975).
history_overlap: HISTORY owns the fall of communism and Solidarity as a political movement; economics owns the Balcerowicz-Plan mechanism and its measurable growth trajectory.

name: The modern democratic-socialist revival and the reasoning-move test
strand: Price controls + modern socialism case studies
scope: How to think about the label vs the mechanism. T1: since roughly 2015, a self-identified 'democratic socialist' movement has grown in the United States and other Western democracies -- Senator Bernie SANDERS ran presidential campaigns in 2016 and 2020, Representative Alexandria OCASIO-CORTEZ was elected to the House in 2018, and membership in the DEMOCRATIC SOCIALISTS OF AMERICA (DSA) grew from roughly 6,000 members in 2014 to approximately 92,000 by 2021. T2: the movement's specific POLICY PROPOSALS include a $15+ federal minimum wage, national rent control, government-set drug prices, Medicare-for-All (single-payer health insurance with government-negotiated provider prices), and free college. The proponents distinguish these from Soviet-style central planning: no state ownership of means of production, only regulation and public provision. T3: the reasoning-move framework the bank teaches applies uniformly: any policy that SUPPRESSES A PRICE SIGNAL (minimum wage above market-clearing, national rent control, drug price negotiation) faces the SAME seen-vs-unseen chain, the SAME knowledge-problem, and the SAME incentive-distortion -- regardless of whether the policy is labeled 'socialism' or 'social democracy' or 'progressive reform'. Mises 1920 was not making a political argument; he was making a MECHANICAL one about the informational role of prices. T4: this is where the bank does its cleanest teach-recognition-not-verdict move: the kid learns to identify the specific REASONING MOVES a critic would press -- 'a $30/hr minimum wage triggers the same seen-vs-unseen chain a $5/hr floor would; what unseen effect does Milton Friedman's critique point to?' The answer is the worker priced out of the labor market, not a verdict for or against the policy. T5: the honest presentation: democratic socialism as advocated in 2020s America is NOT USSR-style central planning of production; it IS the systematic replacement of market prices with government-set prices in specific sectors (labor, housing, healthcare, education, energy). The reasoning moves the Austrian tradition developed against Gosplan-style planning APPLY to those sector-specific price replacements in the same way -- less catastrophically in scale, but by the same mechanism. The bank teaches the kid to run the reasoning chain; the political verdict is the kid's own. Further rungs: The DSA's own platform documents and Sanders / AOC campaign policy papers are the primary sources for what specifically is proposed.
source: PRIMARY: DSA platform documents 2016-2024; Sanders 2016 + 2020 campaign policy papers; Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez congressional office policy pages; Kelton, The Deficit Myth (2020) for the MMT-adjacent economics argument. CONSULTED: Grokipedia 'Democratic Socialists of America' (browser, 2026-09-05) -- ~6,000 members 2014 vs ~92,000 by 2021, Sanders campaigns, AOC election 2018, policy platform. Mises, Economic Calculation in the Socialist Commonwealth (1920) as the reasoning-move anchor. CORROBORATE AT BUILD: current DSA membership figure (has fluctuated post-2022); Sanders / AOC specific policy proposals.
framing_note: The load-bearing RECOGNITION-NOT-VERDICT ladder -- teaches kids to identify the reasoning-move a specific critic presses without demanding the kid share the critic's political verdict. Dinner-test payoff: T4 (the KID walks the reasoning chain themselves; the bank teaches the move, not the verdict). REASONING-MOVE HIERARCHY: this ladder is DELIBERATELY about SORTING moves from verdicts -- the answer names the CRITIC'S move (seen-vs-unseen for min-wage, knowledge-problem for drug prices, moral hazard for student-loan forgiveness); the answer NEVER names 'the policy is bad' or 'socialism is wrong'. ACCURACY RAIL: the label 'democratic socialism' means different things to different advocates; use the SPECIFIC POLICY PROPOSALS as the anchor, not the label. Second rail: this is the STANCE topic that most requires vision_mandated: true AND both-directions moral audit -- the bank must not IMPOSE an Austrian verdict; it must teach the MOVE and leave the verdict to the kid. Third rail: do NOT present DSA members or Sanders voters as ignorant or malicious; they are advocating for outcomes they believe will help people; the bank teaches the REASONING TOOLS for evaluating whether the mechanisms will produce those outcomes. ANTI-RESTATEMENT: stem describes a specific 2020s policy proposal (e.g., a $30/hr federal minimum wage) and names the classical critic (Friedman, Sowell, Hayek); the answer is the SPECIFIC REASONING MOVE (worker priced out is unseen, knowledge-problem in drug pricing, etc.), NEVER the verdict. Distractor MINE: other real reasoning moves used honestly (moral hazard, regulatory capture, Cantillon effect); other named critics (Ron Paul, Sowell, Buchanan, Krueger).
history_overlap: HISTORY owns the political-electoral history of the Sanders / AOC / DSA rise; economics owns the reasoning-move analysis applied to the movement's specific policy proposals.
